status: exact cross-carrier quotient and detector specification; no mechanism identification

typedMap.sourceCarrier: central endpoint transport Z = {+I2,-I2} on a coherently marked real two-frame
typedMap.preservedOperation: chi(H2 H1)=chi(H2)chi(H1) for H1,H2 in Z
typedMap.projectorQuotient: A and -A define the same projector P=A^T A
typedMap.readout: chi(H)=sign(tr(H)/2) on the declared central endpoint set

detectorPacket.platform: EX-006 three-mode photonic, microwave or acoustic loop with a coherently referenced two-frame readout
primaryObservables: projector distance between initial and final two-dimensional subspaces
endpoint frame-overlap matrix H=A_final A_initial^T after declared parallel-transport calibration
leakage, insertion loss and process singular values
detectorPacket.positivePattern: projector distance is within its calibrated closure band, H is within its centrality band of -I2 after one traversal and +I2 after two traversals
controls: one traversal followed by a second identical traversal
endpoint reference recalibration without selected-state data
detectorPacket.stopRule: Reject the binary-holonomy claim if an independently calibrated endpoint convention removes the sign, the projector does not close, H is noncentral beyond tolerance, or ordinary static/loss models predict the records.

importantDistinctions: The central -I2 sign is reversal-even because (-I2)^-1=-I2; it is not EX-006's reversal-odd non-Abelian statistic.
The determinant is +1 and therefore cannot be used as the detector.
Projector-only detection necessarily erases the sign.
An engineered realization validates the detector and transfer model, not new physics.
The map identifies an observable type-shape, not Claimipedia, theology and a physical mechanism.
boundary: This bridge proves that one existing science-programme detector can read the same binary return invariant as the proposed Claimipedia sign loop after an explicit central-character quotient. It does not supply Claimipedia's missing authored overlaps, derive a microscopic source for the physical loop or make a theological inference.
